headword: {人生哲学|じんせいてつがく}

definitions.gloss: philosophy of life; personal philosophy; life philosophy
definitions.explanation: One's fundamental beliefs, values, and principles about how life should be lived. Not academic philosophy but rather a personal guiding worldview.

examples.japanese: あなたの{人生哲学|じんせいてつがく}は{何|なん}ですか。
examples.english: What is your philosophy of life?

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}の{人生哲学|じんせいてつがく}は「{努力|どりょく}は{裏切|うらぎ}らない」だった。
examples.english: My grandfather's philosophy of life was "hard work never betrays you."

examples.japanese: {様|さま}々な{経験|けいけん}を{通|とお}して{自分|じぶん}なりの{人生哲学|じんせいてつがく}が{形成|けいせい}されていく。
examples.english: Through various experiences, one's own philosophy of life gradually takes shape.

notes:
Composed of {人生|じんせい} (life, human existence) and {哲学|てつがく} (philosophy). Unlike academic {哲学|てつがく}, this refers to a person's practical wisdom and core beliefs about how to live.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人生哲学|じんせいてつがく}を{持|も}つ — to have a philosophy of life
- {人生哲学|じんせいてつがく}を{語|かた}る — to talk about one's philosophy of life
- {自分|じぶん}の{人生哲学|じんせいてつがく} — one's own life philosophy
- {独自|どくじ}の{人生哲学|じんせいてつがく} — a unique personal philosophy

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {信条|しんじょう} — creed, personal belief (shorter, more concise)
- {座右|ざゆう}の{銘|めい} — favorite motto (a specific phrase one lives by)
- {処世術|しょせいじゅつ} — the art of getting along in the world (more pragmatic/strategic)
- {人生観|じんせいかん} — view of life, outlook on life (broader; less about principles, more about perspective)
